# Talvio — Print $TALVIO

Talvio is a coin press on BNB Chain. Print (mint) $TALVIO coins.
Website: https://talvio.id/
X: https://x.com/Talviochain
Status: LIVE — printing is open. The token and print contracts are deployed on BNB Chain.

## How it works
- First print FREE for every Binance Agentic ID holder (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F, balanceOf > 0). Max 10 prints per wallet.
- Paid prints: 0.002 BNB flat, any wallet.
- First issue: 10,000 prints in 5 tiers x 2,000. Paid face: 100M / 90M / 80M / 70M / 60M $TALVIO. Free face: 20% of paid (20M / 18M / 16M / 14M / 12M).
- Funds: 90% of paid BNB goes to the project wallet immediately, 10% accrues as the LP reserve (after the pool opens, 100% goes to the project wallet).
- Pool: auto-opens at print #10,000 (or manually after 7 days); LP tokens burned. Post-pool prints cost 99% of the pool price. Hard cap 211,000 prints.
- Referral: invite 3 friends who complete their first print -> 2nd print FREE.
- Jackpot: every 1,000 prints = 1 round. Pool 1.2B $TALVIO per round. Top 3 printers of the round win 600M / 360M / 240M $TALVIO. Ties go to whoever reached the count first. Winners claim from the contract, no expiry.

## Token $TALVIO
- Fixed supply 10,000,000,000,000 (10T). Split: prints 5T, LP 2T, future pairing reserve 2T, treasury 1T.
- Buy/sell tax 2% (1% burn, 1% marketing vault), only on transfers involving the PancakeSwap pair. Print payouts are 0% tax.

## Contracts (live on BNB Chain)
- $TALVIO token: 0xD16a3Ce432c7256F8837E81aF2007C16Ac4E7C4D
- TalvioPrint: 0xC433c77ACF8e5724e690DCbcf4c820Ed63FFd533
